# SkillWheel

`world-system`

The skill wheel: each skill tier is a node with an affinity per profession (which pulls it toward that profession on the rim) and a depth (how far from the centre it sits), plus what the tier unlocks.

> Draw skills as a wheel of professions with shared skills in the centre instead of a grid of tiers (Phase 271)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| professions | json | Profession ids, in rim order |
| professionSkills | json | { <profession>: [skills it is built from] } |
| nodes | json | { "<Skill>:<tier>": { skill, tier, depth, affinity, requires, unlock } } |
